sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:30281
Court No. - 19
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 13857 of 2023

Applicant :- Mo. Irfan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Shivam Srivastava,Firoz Ahmad Khan,Vikas Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Prashant Singh Gaur,Sudhanshu Mishra
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Firoz Ahmad Khan, the learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Anand Pratap Singh,
learned A.G.A. for the State and Shri Shivam Srivastava, Advocate holding brief of Shri Sudhanshu
Mishra, learned counsel for the complainant and perused the record.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
201 of 2023, under Section 406, 420, 411 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Jahangeerganj, District Ambedkar Nagar.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 06.08.2023 against the applicant and one Hifzurrahman alleging that the applicant had taken money from the informants in the name of getting visas issued to them.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is Mo. Irfan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

sentences.text: 5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail application but he could not dispute the aforesaid facts.
6. Learned counsel for the applicant states that the applicant is ready to refund the amount of Rs.2,25,000/- that was paid by the informant to him, as soon as the applicant is released on bail.
7. Learned counsel for the complainant has no objection to the aforesaid offer made by the learned counsel for the applicant.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 07.08.2023; co-accused has already been granted bail, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

10. Let the applicant- Mo. Irfan be released on bail in the aforesaid case, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned,
subject to the following conditions: -
(i) the applicant will pay the disputed amount of Rs.2,25,000/- to the informant by way of bank transfer within a period of 7 days' from the date of his release from custody.
(ii) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(iii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iv) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
.
[Subhash Vidyarthi, J.]

Order Date :- 16.4.2024 -Amit K-
